sentences.en: They say we'll have an earthquake one of these days.
sentences.zh: 他们说迟早会有一场地震。

sentences.en: When the earthquake occurred, I happened to be watching TV.
sentences.zh: 地震发生的时候，我正好在看电视。

sentences.en: We may have a very severe earthquake any moment now.
sentences.zh: 现在随时都可能来一场严重的地震。

senses.zh: 地震 - 动乱, 大震荡
